comment: Read by scripts/audit-check.mjs, keyed by ghsa and package. Each path comes from `npm explain`; the check does not verify it.

exceptions.reason: Build tool: @expo/cli runs on the developer machine and in CI, zod is absent from the iOS and Android bundle source maps (29/10). @expo/cli 57 requires zod ^3.25.76; the fix (4.6.6) needs another Expo SDK.

Shipped in the app: it decodes scanandstock:// links and route parameters, so a malformed link can slow the app down (denial of service, no data exposed). expo-router 57 has no fixed version; kept by decision of 2026-10-26 until expo-router drops query-string 7 (expo-router 58 still requires ^7.1.3, 30/10).

Shipped in the app: it decodes scanandstock:// links and route parameters, so a malformed link can slow the app down (denial of service, no data exposed). The fix (0.5.1) is ESM-only: query-string 7 loads it with require and its parse throws 'decodeComponent is not a function' (30/10). Kept by decision of 2026-10-30 until expo-router drops query-string 7 (expo-router 58 still requires ^7.1.3, 30/10), like GHSA-vcc3-ghjq-m6fr.

Build tool: glob is used by @expo/cli, @expo/config, @expo/config-plugins, @expo/fingerprint, @expo/metro-config and expo-updates on the developer machine and in CI, and is absent from the iOS and Android bundle source maps (04/11). The fix (14.0.2) is another major: @expo/cli 58 and @expo/fingerprint 0.21 still require glob ^13.0.0 (04/11).

Build tool: minimatch is used by @expo/fingerprint and glob on the developer machine and in CI, and is absent from the iOS and Android bundle source maps (04/11). The fix (11.0.1) is another major: @expo/fingerprint 0.21 and glob 13 still require minimatch ^10.2.2 (04/11), and glob stays on 13 for GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4.
